Name: CurvatureSensitivity
Label: Curvature sensitivity
Description: Controls how quickly raw curvature reaches the normalized feature response.
Tooltip: Increase this when ridges or valleys are too faint.

Name: Feature
Label: Feature
Description: Chooses convex ridges or concave valleys.
Tooltip: Ridge and valley strength are evaluated from the same stable curvature signal.

Name: Threshold
Label: Minimum feature strength
Description: Minimum normalized ridge or valley response to include.
Tooltip: Raise this to reject weak broad curvature and keep only pronounced features.
